problems.problem: Bottle appears to float without visible contact shadow or surface cues. The product_base_y (1245) is 86.5% of canvas height (1440), but the shadow.offset_y (0) is detached from the bottle base, violating contact shadow physics. No visible fabric texture or fold at the bottle's base to confirm surface contact.
Bottle occupies 59% of canvas height (850/1440), slightly below the 50-65% hero standard. The left negative space is overly large, creating imbalance with the right-aligned bottle.

Compared to professional references (e.g., Armani/Prive, Tom Ford), the composition lacks dramatic lighting integration and text hierarchy. The typography feels generic and disconnected from the bottle's luxury aesthetic.
